scenes.title: At night in the old observatory Leo turns the mi
scenes.text: At night in the old observatory Leo turns the mirror wheels until a moonbeam strikes the crystal and the dome opens.

scenes.title: A thief snatches the star map and Leo chases him
scenes.text: A thief snatches the star map and Leo chases him through the crowded night market, vaulting the crates he topples.

scenes.title: Leo poles a punt through the mangrove swamp whil
scenes.text: Leo poles a punt through the mangrove swamp while crocodiles lunge from the dark water.

scenes.title: Deep in the jungle Leo swings from vine to vine
scenes.text: Deep in the jungle Leo swings from vine to vine across a ravine toward the ancient temple.

scenes.title: Inside the desert temple a giant boulder is rele
scenes.text: Inside the desert temple a giant boulder is released and Leo outruns it, jumps the pit and slides under the closing door.

scenes.title: In the ice cave Leo leaps between drifting ice f
scenes.text: In the ice cave Leo leaps between drifting ice floes while stalactites crash around him.

scenes.title: At the volcano forge Leo hammers a glowing sword
scenes.text: At the volcano forge Leo hammers a glowing sword on the anvil beside the lava river and quenches it.

scenes.title: Leo dives into the coral reef, opens a giant cla
scenes.text: Leo dives into the coral reef, opens a giant clam for the pearl and escapes a shark.

scenes.title: Leo sprints across the rotten rope bridge as the
scenes.text: Leo sprints across the rotten rope bridge as the planks fall away behind him.

scenes.title: Leo crosses the floating city, riding the moving
scenes.text: Leo crosses the floating city, riding the moving platforms above the clouds.

scenes.title: A stone giant lifts its arm and Leo rides the pa
scenes.text: A stone giant lifts its arm and Leo rides the palm, walks to the shoulder and pulls the glowing core from its chest.

scenes.title: On the moonlit tower the rival mage and Leo trad
scenes.text: On the moonlit tower the rival mage and Leo trade spells in a magic duel, and Leo's shield turns the last spell back.
